title: The bird on the corkboard
logline: Gully's corkboard with the bird on its top edge, among the pins: the 2003 rough, the lost-cat flyers, the tide table, the 61 MI postcard, the red-framed crab, TAKE-OUT ONLY. The bird is the only thing on the board not pinned.

panels.composition: A crowded shop corkboard: a pencil rough of a man hanging a sign, lost-cat flyers, a tide table, a postcard with marker on its face, a small red-framed crab drawing, a hand-lettered card, and the small rainbow bird perched on the board's top edge.
